notes: HIP 17453 A is a chemically peculiar A0V star at 80.5 pc (Gaia). HIP 17453 B is a co-moving brown-dwarf companion (~53 Mjup, L2+-1) discovered with Keck/NIRC2 over a ~10-year astrometric baseline in the C-BASS survey (Brinjikji+2026).
